notes: Openspec produced empty acceptanceCriteria with a note that this is a novel capability. I derived all 18 ACs from scratch based on the story description and the codebase context (useContent hook with 236 callers, Contentstack service layer). ACs cover: core live-preview behaviour (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3), opt-out/fallback (AC-4), partial field merging (AC-5), rapid-update resilience (AC-6), SDK failure fallback (AC-7), connection loss (AC-8), unsupported content types (AC-9), preview token security (AC-10), session persistence (AC-11), entry mismatch guard (AC-12), unknown field guard (AC-13), publish transition (AC-14), multi-hook isolation (AC-15), render efficiency (AC-16), complex field types (AC-17), and null/empty payload guard (AC-18). All ACs are written as observable outcomes (Given/When/Then) with no implementation instructions. Per openspec's note, Contentstack hosts are unreachable at test time, so ACs are scoped to observable behaviour at the application boundary.
